data.raw_text:
> Steve Reeves
> born in 1926 (Montana, a small town near the Canadian border)
> father was a rancher, killed in a farming accident when Steve was young
> mother raised him alone, they moved to Oakland, California when he was 10
> one day on the route he arm wrestled a boy who lived nearby (a boy smaller than him)
> the smaller boy won
> Steve found out the boy trained with weights in his garage
> Steve started training, then found his way to Ed Yarick's gym in Oakland
> Yarick became a father figure to Steve
> steve walked in at 163 lbs
> four months later he was 193 lbs
> his genetics were unlike anything Yarick had seen
> graduated high school 1944, enlisted in the US Army immediately
> assigned to Company A of the 25th Division, sent to the Philippines
> his fellow soldiers nicknamed him "The Shape"
> caught malaria in the Pacific, lost 25 lbs
> during the occupation of Japan he found weights and started building himself back up
> left the Army September 1946 after 26 months of service
> walked straight back into Yarick's gym
> won Mr. Pacific Coast 1946 (his first competition)
> Won it again 1947 (also took Best Chest, Best Arms and Best Legs the same night)
> won Mr. America 1947
> won Mr. World 1948
> flew to London, won Mr. Universe 1950
> the night he won Mr. Universe he stood on stage and announced his retirement from bodybuilding
> moved to New York to study acting under Stella Adler
> they argued, she refunded his tuition
> studied elsewhere, started doing vaudeville acts with a comedian named Dick Burney
> one of Cecil B. DeMille's scouts spotted him
> DeMille cast him as Samson opposite Hedy Lamarr, told him to lose 15 lbs
> Steve couldn't do it, they gave the role to Victor Mature
> the film broke box office records
> Steve spent years in bit parts going nowhere
> then an Italian director's daughter pointed to his photo and said "him"
> Steve's fee for Hercules was $10,000
> by 1960 he was the number one box office draw in 25 countries, ahead of John Wayne
> Highest paid actor in Europe
> Turned down James Bond in Dr. No, 1962
> Turned down the lead in A Fistful of Dollars (the role went to Clint Eastwood)
> A shoulder injury from a chariot stunt ended his acting career
> Retired to a ranch, bred horses, invented Powerwalking, campaigned against steroids until he died
> Died 1 May 2000, aged 74

Arnold Schwarzenegger said: "If I could push a button to look like Steve Reeves in Hercules or Arnold in Conan, I'd push the Steve Reeves button"
